# Rear disc brake conversion (WD22)

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

Disconnect parking brake cables, remove axle shafts with ABS sensors, replace inner seals, then slide in new disc brake axles. [t1134]

## Tools

- [Partial] Axle tool (optional but recommended for bearing press) [t1134]

## Parts

- ABS sensors [t1134]
- Disc brake axle shafts [t1134]
- [Partial] Hard brake lines with flare nuts [t1134]
- Inner seals [t1134]
- Parking brake cables, or universal console pull [t1134]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use longer bolts or studs if the original drum backing plate is too thick for standard disc studs. [t1134]
- [Partial] Consider using hex grade 10.9 nuts to allow wrench access against the wide axle shaft. [t1134]

## Common mistakes

- [Partial] Pressing a bearing race out while leaving the cup in place (requires removing cup first). [t1134]
- Binding bearings if not seated correctly after swapping longer studs. [t1134]
- [Partial] Forgetting to check flare nut pitch and size compatibility between hard and soft lines. [t1134]
